Our salon off US Hwy 31 near Baxter YMCA is a reliable stop for dog grooming in Indianapolis. If you just need the basics, walk-in quick services off E Stop 11 Rd include nail grind, teeth brushing, and ear cleaning. We also offer complete spa packages and Seasonal Specials, so every pet in your household has an option.
